propositions: Close-gate verification fails with 'insufficient evidence' when evidence search exhausts step budget without refuting any criterion, but should auto-resume the verifier instead of surfacing to operator

The resumption loop qualifies for auto-resume only when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker and at least one unmet record exists (insufficiency-only condition)

Auto-resume re-invokes verify_completion with identical arguments against the same pinned ref, seeding credited PASSes from the verdict cache to concentrate remaining budget on previously-insufficient criteria

Resumption is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2, configurable; 0 disables) and by progress—dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased cache-credited PASS count; zero progress stops early and surfaces failure

Per-attempt trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining criteria) is recorded in the verdict metadata and ticket output; exhausted resumptions surface existing failure with attempts-count message
